summary: This document extends BGP route reflectors so they choose the best route from the viewpoint of their clients instead of their own, using IGP cost from configured locations. It can be per client, per group or for all clients, and helps deployments with centralized route reflectors that want hot potato routing.

eli5.summary: A middle manager normally picks what is best from their own desk. This document makes the manager pick what is best from the worker's desk instead.
